tasks.old_behavior: The SetManaged D-Bus method accepted (boolean managed, uint32 flags) as input parameters. D-Bus signature was (bu). Any D-Bus client could call SetManaged(TRUE/FALSE, flags) using the boolean type.
tasks.new_behavior: The SetManaged D-Bus method now accepts (uint32 managed, uint32 flags). D-Bus signature changed to (uu). The managed parameter accepts 0=NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_NO, 1=NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_YES, or 2=NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_RESET.
tasks.compatibility_reason: D-Bus is strict about type signatures. Any existing client sending (bu) will receive a D-Bus TYPE_MISMATCH error because the expected signature is now (uu). This breaks backward compatibility for all D-Bus clients of the SetManaged method, including libnm users and direct D-Bus callers.
tasks.test_recommendation: Test SetManaged with old signature (bu) fails with TYPE_MISMATCH. Test (uu) with values 0, 1, 2 all work. Test both RUNTIME and PERMANENT flag combinations.

tasks.old_behavior: nm_device_set_managed_async() accepted gboolean (int) for the managed parameter. Callers could pass TRUE/FALSE or any integer value.
tasks.new_behavior: nm_device_set_managed_async() accepts NMDeviceManaged enum. Callers must use NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_NO, NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_YES, or NM_DEVICE_MANAGED_RESET.
tasks.compatibility_reason: gboolean and C enum are both int-sized, so ABI compatibility is preserved. However, source compatibility is broken: existing code passing gboolean literals (TRUE/FALSE) will fail to compile. The old deprecated synchronous API nm_device_set_managed(gboolean) is preserved as a migration path.
tasks.test_recommendation: Compile existing code using nm_device_set_managed_async to verify compiler warnings. Test that old gboolean values still produce correct behavior (TRUE=1=YES, FALSE=0=NO).
